public pure function active_knots(knot, nc, degree) result(Xth)

Return distinct stored knots on the closed active interval. A nondecreasing knot vector is a mathematical precondition. Invalid degree/count/size metadata returns an allocated zero-length array; other knot-vector invariants are not checked here.
